blocks.text: 4.3 Initiative charters
Each initiative has a one-page charter that a lead can run from and Steerco can hold to account.

Every charter uses the same fields. It states the objective, the focus areas served, the proposed lead and partners and the tier of government. It then sets the actions in each phase, marked Design or Implement, and closes with the dependencies, the funding route, the risks and the indicators it moves. Actions come from the Chapter 3 action tables. Leads are proposals for Steerco to confirm, and rand bands are set in section 4.6.
